The best avocado cream combo to gift depends on the person. For someone new to skincare, the Day & Night Combo (₹849) is the easy, safe choice. For someone who loves a proper routine, the Korean Glass Skin Kit (₹1,999) feels like a real present. And for a small token, a single jar does the job.

With Diwali on Sunday 8 November 2026, Bhai Dooj a few days later and wedding season starting, this is the time of year we get asked about gifting most. Here's how to pick an avocado skincare gift set, what each set saves you, and when to order so it arrives on time.

Which set for whom

Mother, mother-in-law or an aunt: Day & Night Combo

Simple wins here. One light cream for the morning, one rich cream for night, and nothing to figure out. The Avocado Night Cream is our most nourishing one, which suits skin that feels drier with age and in a North Indian winter. Our skincare gift for mother guide has more ideas.

Sister, cousin or best friend into K-beauty: Korean Glass Skin Kit

Three jars, a full morning-and-night routine, and it looks generous when it's opened. Good for someone in their 20s or 30s who already enjoys skincare and wants a brighter, more radiant-looking glow. It also makes a thoughtful Bhai Dooj gift from a brother who has no idea what to buy.

Wife, partner or someone with a routine already: Night Cream Combo

Two full-size night creams: Glutathione Cream for radiance and Avocado Night Cream for comfort. She can alternate them, one night each, which makes both jars last longer. See skincare gift for wife if you want more options.

Colleagues, Secret Santa, return gifts: single jars

  • Avocado Glow Cream 10 g, ₹349. Small enough for a handbag. A neat office gift.
  • Avocado Glow Cream 15g, ₹399. Avocado and aloe vera only, with no kojic acid or niacinamide. The safest pick when you don't know the person's skin.
  • Avocado Night Cream 30 g, ₹649. A proper full jar for someone you know has dry skin.

Who we wouldn't gift a set to

Someone pregnant, someone with a diagnosed skin condition, or someone who's been told by a dermatologist to keep their routine minimal. For them, a single gentle jar (or a non-skincare gift) is kinder. Products with kojic acid aren't the right surprise for everyone.

How to get it there before Diwali

We ship from Bhatkal in Karnataka, and delivery usually takes 3–7 days depending on where you are. Couriers are busy around festivals, so leave a little buffer. Here's what we'd plan around:

  1. For Dhanteras (Friday 6 November): order by about 30 October.
  2. For Diwali (Sunday 8 November): order by about 1 November.
  3. For Bhai Dooj (Wednesday 11 November): order by about 4 November.
  4. Sending straight to someone else's home? Give us their full address with pincode and a phone number they'll actually pick up. Couriers call before delivery.
  5. Track it. Once it's shipped, follow it on our track order page.

Ordering is on WhatsApp. Tell us the set, the address and whether it's a gift. If you're buying lots of sets for staff or clients, look at skincare gifts in bulk for Diwali instead.

Wedding season and birthdays

From November to February, it can feel like everyone you know is getting married. A skincare set is a quiet, useful gift for a bride-to-be or a friend who'll be attending five functions back to back. Late nights, heavy make-up and travel leave skin dry and tired, and a good night cream helps it feel comfortable again. If you're gifting a bride, send it at least a month before the wedding, not the week of. Nobody should start a new cream right before the big day. Our winter wedding skincare guide explains why.

Birthdays are easier. There's no festive courier rush, so a week's notice is usually plenty.

Small gifting etiquette that matters

  • Keep the jar sealed. Don't open it to "check". A sealed jar looks better, feels more hygienic, and our 7-day returns only apply to sealed jars.
  • Add a note card. Something short like "Try a little behind your ear or on the side of your neck for a day before using it on your face." It's caring, not preachy.
  • Mention sunscreen. Most of our avocado creams and the Glutathione Cream contain kojic acid, so a line like "sunscreen in the morning" on the card is genuinely helpful.
  • Don't promise a change in skin colour. It won't, and it isn't a kind thing to imply. These creams are about soft, comfortable, fresh-looking skin.
  • Pair it simply. A set with a diya, a box of dry fruits or a handwritten card says plenty.

Still deciding?

If you're torn between two sets, pick the simpler one. A gift that gets used every night beats a bigger one that sits in a drawer. Browse all our skincare gift sets, or see the wider list in Diwali skincare gift ideas.

What is the cheapest avocado cream combo? The Day & Night Combo at ₹849, which is ₹149 less than buying the two jars separately.

Which avocado skincare gift set is best for a beginner? The Day & Night Combo. One cream for the morning, one for night, nothing complicated.

When should I order for Diwali 2026? By about 1 November, since delivery usually takes 3–7 days.

Can I send the gift directly to someone else? Yes. Share their full address, pincode and phone number when you order on WhatsApp.

Is the gift returnable? Sealed jars can be returned within 7 days. Opened jars can't, so keep it sealed until it's given.

This is general skincare information, not medical advice. Patch test any new product, and see a dermatologist if you have a skin condition.
